title: Rainbow Around the Moon
about: “There's a rainbow around the moon — in the night, in the pale night light, you can see the magic rings.” Printed with chords in Rainbow Caravan and indexed in Rainbow Kirtan, and carried on the Sounds from the Rainbow compilations by the trio recording that appears on Heartsongs Vol. 1 and 6 and the Pennsylvania Prism 2021 set. The melody here follows that recording (CC BY-NC-SA).
